coaching.headline: Won the duo lane and nothing else: one tower to ten, first Fangtooth conceded with five alive, zero wards cleared.
coaching.team: We lost this on the map, not in the duo lane. Skylar died three times before minute 10 and Kira finished with 10 kills. Yet the first Fangtooth fell at minute 10 with all five of us alive and nobody contesting, right after we won the fight at 8, 3-2, for nothing. River buffs went 5 to 19, seedlings 0 to 2, and we destroyed zero wards to their six. The fight at 13.3, won 2-0, was cashed into Mini Prime and our only tower. Then the outer-tower defense at 15.9 lost 1-3 and the river fight at 20.5, lost 1-4 but traded into the Fangtooth we took in the same window. The inner-tower fight at 24 opened 4v5 forty seconds after Feng Mao was caught alone. They won eight fights and converted five; we won three and converted one. Next game: the first Fangtooth is never left uncontested with five alive.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The first Fangtooth, conceded at minute 10 with five alive and no contest, set the tempo; the solo catch on Feng Mao at 23.3 decided it. Forty seconds later we fought at our inner tower 4v5, lost 1-4, and two inner towers and an inhibitor followed.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane did its job: Skylar died three times before minute 10, six times to Kira overall. The fight at 13.3, won 2-0 by Scarlett and Feng Mao, went straight into Mini Prime.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mid was ours on paper and produced a losing line. Gadget finished 4 kills and 8 deaths against Renna's 9 and 6, and Renna ended with 42,947 damage to heroes on five items to Gadget's three. Three of the four kills were on Serath. None of the eight deaths were solo; each was the call to take a fight.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: The jungle lost the objective game. River buffs went 5 to 19, and Serath did 42,479 objective damage to Feng Mao's 9,522. Nine deaths, the most on our side, with no armor against three physical threats. The solo catch by Serath at 23.3 decided it: forty seconds later the inner-tower fight opened 4v5. A solo catch in each of his last four films.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett donated first blood and then never touched a structure. Caught alone by Grux at minute 2, then zero damage to objectives on a team that took one tower. The rest held up: three kills, the most damage mitigated on our side at 50,061, and the kill on Renna in the fight at 13.3, won 2-0, beside Mini Prime.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco did the support job and lost the ward war. Fifty-eight percent kill participation, a 34% assist share, 15,581 healing, no deaths before minute 10, never first to die in a fight. Twelve wards to Mourn's 23, none of theirs destroyed, is the gap. The solo catch by Skylar at 27.5 came right before their Primal Fangtooth at 28.2.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira won her lane and then kept dying to the same hero. Ten kills, six of them on Skylar, the most on our side. Three of her six deaths were to Renna, all after minute 20, with nobody on the team holding magic resist against 42,947 damage to heroes.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Gadget went 4 kills to 8 deaths against Renna's 9 and 6, in the lane that was supposed to be ours.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Feng Mao's solo catch at 23.3 turned the inner-tower fight into a 4v5, and river buffs went 5 to 19 all game.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Scarlett gave Grux first blood alone at minute 2 and put zero damage on objectives all game.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Maco hit 58% participation with zero deaths before minute 10, but 12 wards to Mourn's 23 lost the ward war.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Kira produced the only winning lane, ten kills with six on Skylar, and still died three times to Renna after minute 20.

3a06bc60-b09d-426d-9e39-a530c79a32c1.text: Skylar died seven times, six of them to Kira and three before minute 10, and his team won around him anyway.

2498a917-4caa-4d44-9677-bb8ed454b984.text: Mourn placed 23 wards while dying once, and their side destroyed six of ours to our zero; the vision gap was his.

32b1a9dd-00d5-4ef9-9c2d-7f748325ba5e.text: Renna led everyone with 42,947 damage to heroes on 9 kills, and none of our five bought magic resist.

539637ce-9bc4-43c4-a865-e468df0182ee.text: Grux took first blood on Scarlett alone at minute 2 and closed with kills on Kira and Feng Mao late.

fe95a5a6-6573-4ba3-a9cb-d350f02d621b.text: Serath did 42,479 damage to objectives, the most in the match, and caught Feng Mao alone at 23.3 before the 4v5.

24.call: Lost before it started: 4v5 at our inner tower, forty seconds after Feng Mao was caught alone, and it ended 1-4 with two inner towers and an inhibitor gone. At four bodies, back off and wait for the fifth.

13.3.call: The one fight we converted. Scarlett and Feng Mao won it 2-0 beside Mini Prime and our only tower of the game followed. Win the fight, take the prize in the same minute: that is the whole method.

15.9.call: Hold the tower, do not fight in front of it. Gadget, Feng Mao and Kira died in sequence, the fight went 1-3, two outer towers fell in the next minute, then Fangtooth at 16.8 with all three still dead.

20.5.call: It went 1-4 in open river, four of us dead for one kill, and the Fangtooth we took in the same window is the only thing it bought. A trade, and an expensive one: the call was to group for the Fangtooth without the river fight first.

22.5.call: Fangtooth was ours, but Kira and Gadget died 0-2 to Grux and Skylar during the take, Feng Mao was caught alone by Serath at 23.3, and the inner tower fell at 23.5 with three of us dead. A major taken while two bodies are lost is not a trade won.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Soulbinder, Combustion and Tainted Scepter is long-range poke with anti-heal for Mourn; the core of Azure Core, Entropy and Overseer trades that for a shield when hit and self-healing on damage dealt. Bigger gap: three items to Renna's five, 12,016 gold against 17,873, and eight deaths kept it there.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh fits Gadget's zone kit: gate, mines and dome all land ability hits, and Vesh turns each into a damage-over-time, with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot adding ultimate damage and current-health damage inside the dome.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Malady and Painweaver are the core; Manta Scythe took Omen's slot, trading Omen's cooldown refund and empowered hit for bonus damage on isolated targets. The gap that showed was defensive: no armor at all, and five of the nine deaths were to Serath, Grux and Skylar, the three physical threats.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis suits a duelist who wins by sticking to one target through Reaping Dash and Hamstring: every third consecutive hit on the same hero deals max-health damage, and Serration adds missing-health damage right where Earth Shatter's execute finishes.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No field core exists for Scarlett offlane; the durability set of Tainted Guard, Overlord, Terminus and Syonic Echo held up, with 50,061 damage mitigated, the most on our side, so nothing to teach here.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex fits a sustained duelist who trades basic attacks through a long lane fight: marking the last hero hit raises Scarlett's damage to them and lowers theirs to her, and Savage Strikes adds on-hit damage, which is the Grux matchup in one sentence.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Maco on Hexbound Bracers, Gaia Greaves and Everbloom without Crescelia, Enra's Blessing or Windcaller; no fight in this game isolates the difference, so nothing to teach here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Tainted Rounds, Ruination, Imperator and Terminus, without Solaris or Ashbringer. No fight here isolates that gap; the three deaths to Renna land on the team-wide zero magic resist, which this build shares.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis fits a carry who stacks Vengeance on one target: every third hit in a row on the same hero adds damage scaled to their max health, and Serration adds missing-health damage, so it rewards exactly the sustained focus that killed Skylar six times.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
enemyKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
enemyKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up
